name: – Recital P
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text: whereas the Conference of the Parties (COP) to the WHO FCTC recognises HTPs as tobacco products and therefore as subject to the provisions of the WHO FCTC, as noted in Decision FCTC/COP8(22); whereas the COP8 concluded by urging the parties to the WHO FCTC to prioritise measures that protect people from exposure to HTP emissions and to explicitly extend smoke-free laws to include HTPs;
